title: Judge Lets Stock Perpetual Futures Keep Trading but Says CFTC Likely Overstepped Its Authority
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Judge Lets Stock Perpetual Futures Keep Trading but Says CFTC Likely Overstepped Its Authority

A federal judge refused to halt stock perpetual futures on Kalshi, Coinbase Derivatives and Bitnomial but found a Cboe- and Citadel Securities-backed group likely to prove the CFTC exceeded its authority.

This post Judge Lets Stock Perpetual Futures Keep Trading but Says CFTC Likely Overstepped Its Authority first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: French Bank Credit Mutuel Arkea Confirms Cyberattack as ZachXBT Puts Losses Above $133 Million
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

French Bank Credit Mutuel Arkea Confirms Cyberattack as ZachXBT Puts Losses Above $133 Million

Credit Mutuel Arkea says a cyberattack through a service provider enabled fraudulent transfers from its own account, while ZachXBT puts the theft above $133 million, a figure the bank has not confirmed.

This post French Bank Credit Mutuel Arkea Confirms Cyberattack as ZachXBT Puts Losses Above $133 Million first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: House Democrats Eye Their Own Crypto Market Structure Bill With a Bigger SEC Role After Sweep

House Democrats Eye Their Own Crypto Market Structure Bill With a Bigger SEC Role After Sweep

House Democrats are discussing a crypto market structure bill built on Rep. Maxine Waters' rejected Clarity Act amendments, with a bigger SEC role, a smaller CFTC role and new ethics limits on President Trump.

This post House Democrats Eye Their Own Crypto Market Structure Bill With a Bigger SEC Role After Sweep first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

Bitcoin price holds near $80,000 after rebounding from an election-night low of $75,600, as a short squeeze, a stock rally and a 9% drop in oil follow the Democratic sweep of Congress.

title: Matt Corallo Flags Critical Linux Kernel Flaw; Lightning Labs Ships LND Mitigation
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Matt Corallo Flags Critical Linux Kernel Flaw; Lightning Labs Ships LND Mitigation

Bitcoin Core and Lightning developer Matt Corallo highlighted CVE-2026-98432 on October 30, a use-after-free in the Linux kernel IPv4 TCP handshake code scored CVSS 9.8. Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team demonstrated a remote root exploit against systems with a Multipath TCP listener.

This post Matt Corallo Flags Critical Linux Kernel Flaw; Lightning Labs Ships LND Mitigation first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt.
